sloka: च्युता गृहाच्च राज्याच्च रामहस्ताच्च मैथिली।किं तवैषा ऽपराद्धा हि यदेनां हन्तुमिच्छसि ।। ६.८१.२२ ।।
transliteration: cyutā gṛhācca rājyācca rāmahastācca maithilī।kiṁ tavaiṣā 'parāddhā hi yadenāṁ hantumicchasi ।। 6.81.22 ।।

translations.english: "You deserve to be killed by the world here. Giving up your life, you will be thrown out and descend to the world with those who killed women have gone, after your death."
